---
title: "Are candidate transcripts eIF3d targets in hypoxia? (MDA-MB-231 and MCF7-SIX1)"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
params:
  transcript_csv: "set1_5utr_transcripts.csv"
  lfc: 0.5
  padj: 0.05
---

**Question.** For a list of candidate transcripts (positive-control candidates for reporters),
is each one an eIF3d translation target in hypoxia, in MDA-MB-231 and in MCF7-SIX1?

**Definition of "eIF3d target" used here.** A gene whose translation efficiency (TE) drops on
eIF3d knockdown: TE log2 fold change (sictrl / si3d, promotes-positive) > `params$lfc` and
`te_padj` < `params$padj`. This is exactly the definition behind the existing gene sets
`hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv` (MDA-MB-231) and
`mcf7six1_hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv` (MCF7-SIX1); both are reproduced and asserted
below. The opposite call ("eIF3d inhibits") is TE log2 fold change < -`params$lfc` at the same padj.

**Important caveat: the TE data is gene-level.** DESeq2 was run on gene counts, so the answer
is about the *gene*, not the specific isoform you gave. Section 4 reports whether the isoform
you gave is the same one our feature matrices treat as the dominant isoform in each cell line.

Add a new set by writing another CSV with columns `set, symbol_given, transcript_id_given` in
this folder and knitting with `params = list(transcript_csv = "<file>.csv")`.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!exists("params") || !is.list(params)) {
  params <- list(transcript_csv = "set1_5utr_transcripts.csv", lfc = 0.5, padj = 0.05)
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(here)
  library(GenomicFeatures)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
})
out_dir <- here("output", "finding_positive_controls")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
set_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(params$transcript_csv))
```

## 1. Candidate transcripts -> genes

Transcripts are mapped to genes through the GENCODE v49 transcript database on the
**version-stripped** transcript ID, so a version mismatch between your ID and v49 does not
lose the transcript. The symbol you gave is checked against the mapped gene, never used to map.

```{r candidates}
cand <- read_csv(here("code", "finding_positive_controls", params$transcript_csv),
                 show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(transcript_id_given = str_trim(transcript_id_given),
         transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", transcript_id_given),
         symbol_given        = str_trim(symbol_given))
stopifnot(all(c("set", "symbol_given", "transcript_id_given") %in% names(cand)),
          !anyDuplicated(cand$transcript_id_clean))

txdb <- loadDb(here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))
tx2gene <- AnnotationDbi::select(txdb, keys = keys(txdb, "TXNAME"), keytype = "TXNAME",
                                 columns = c("TXNAME", "GENEID")) %>%
  transmute(transcript_id_v49   = TXNAME,
            transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", TXNAME),
            gene_id_v49         = GENEID,
            gene_id_clean       = sub("\\..*", "", GENEID))

anno <- read_tsv(here("accessories", "human", "gene_anno_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv"),
                 col_names = c("gene_id", "symbol", "biotype", "species", "source"),
                 show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  distinct(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id), symbol)

cand <- cand %>%
  left_join(tx2gene, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  left_join(anno, by = "gene_id_clean")

unmapped <- cand %>% filter(is.na(gene_id_clean))
if (nrow(unmapped) > 0) {
  cat("Transcripts NOT in GENCODE v49:", paste(unmapped$transcript_id_given, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
cand %>%
  mutate(version_matches_v49 = transcript_id_given == transcript_id_v49,
         symbol_matches      = toupper(symbol_given) == symbol) %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol_given, transcript_id_given, transcript_id_v49, version_matches_v49,
                gene_id_clean, symbol, symbol_matches) %>%
  knitr::kable()

stopifnot("a given symbol disagrees with the gene its transcript maps to" =
            all(toupper(cand$symbol_given) == cand$symbol, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## 2. TE results

**MDA-MB-231.** `translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_{1,4,24}hr.csv`. The filename
says si3d_vs_sictrl but the DESeq2 coefficient is **sictrl_vs_si3d**, so positive `te_lfc`
= eIF3d promotes. Verified below: EIF3D's own `rna_lfc` must be strongly positive.

**MCF7-SIX1.** `translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_mcf7six1_hypoxia_1hr.csv` is already
negated from the raw log2(si3d / sictrl) (`source_log2FoldChange`), so positive `te_lfc` =
eIF3d promotes, matching 231. Only 1hr exists for MCF7-SIX1, and there is no `rna_lfc`, so the
231 direction check cannot run; instead we assert the negation and EIF3D's own TE sign
(raw TE of the depleted factor is positive, +1.79, so the negated value must be negative).

```{r load_te}
read_231 <- function(tp) {
  read_csv(here("output", sprintf("translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_%s.csv", tp)),
           show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
}
te231 <- set_names(c("1hr", "4hr", "24hr")) %>% map(read_231)

for (tp in names(te231)) {
  e <- te231[[tp]] %>% filter(symbol == "EIF3D") %>% pull(rna_lfc)
  cat(sprintf("231 hypoxia %s: EIF3D rna_lfc = %.2f\n", tp, e))
  stopifnot("231 direction flipped: EIF3D rna_lfc should be strongly positive" = e > 1.5)
}

te_mcf <- read_csv(here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_mcf7six1_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
                   show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
stopifnot("MCF7-SIX1 te_lfc is not the negation of the source LFC" =
            isTRUE(all.equal(te_mcf$te_lfc, -te_mcf$source_log2FoldChange)))
e_mcf <- te_mcf %>% filter(symbol == "EIF3D") %>% pull(te_lfc)
cat(sprintf("MCF7-SIX1 hypoxia 1hr: EIF3D te_lfc (promotes-positive) = %.2f\n", e_mcf))
stopifnot("MCF7-SIX1 direction check failed" = e_mcf < -1)
```

### Reproduce the existing gene sets (so "target" here means the same thing)

```{r reproduce_genesets}
gs231 <- read_csv(here("output", "genesets", "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE)
gsmcf <- read_csv(here("output", "genesets", "mcf7six1_hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE)
rep231 <- te231[["1hr"]] %>% filter(te_lfc > 0.5, te_padj < 0.05) %>% pull(gene_id_clean)
repmcf <- te_mcf %>% filter(te_lfc > 0.5, te_padj < 0.05) %>% pull(gene_id_clean)
cat("231 set:", length(rep231), "recomputed vs", nrow(gs231), "saved\n")
cat("MCF7-SIX1 set:", length(repmcf), "recomputed vs", nrow(gsmcf), "saved\n")
stopifnot(setequal(rep231, gs231$ensembl_gene), setequal(repmcf, gsmcf$ensembl_gene))
```

## 3. Calls

```{r calls}
call_status <- function(lfc, padj, present) {
  case_when(
    !present                                   ~ "not detected",
    is.na(padj)                                ~ "not tested (padj NA)",
    padj < params$padj & lfc >  params$lfc     ~ "eIF3d TARGET (promotes)",
    padj < params$padj & lfc < -params$lfc     ~ "eIF3d inhibits",
    padj < params$padj                         ~ "significant, |LFC| below cutoff",
    TRUE                                       ~ "not significant"
  )
}

lookup <- function(te, label) {
  cand %>%
    dplyr::select(set, symbol_given, transcript_id_given, gene_id_clean) %>%
    left_join(te %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, te_lfc, te_padj) %>%
                mutate(present = TRUE), by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
    mutate(present = coalesce(present, FALSE),
           status  = call_status(te_lfc, te_padj, present),
           dataset = label)
}

calls_long <- bind_rows(
  lookup(te231[["1hr"]],  "MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 1hr"),
  lookup(te231[["4hr"]],  "MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 4hr"),
  lookup(te231[["24hr"]], "MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 24hr"),
  lookup(te_mcf,          "MCF7-SIX1 hypoxia 1hr")
)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(calls_long[c("transcript_id_given", "dataset")]))

fmt <- function(lfc, padj) ifelse(is.na(lfc), "-", sprintf("%.2f (%.2g)", lfc, padj))
summary_tbl <- calls_long %>%
  mutate(cell = paste0(status, " | ", fmt(te_lfc, te_padj))) %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol_given, transcript_id_given, dataset, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = cell)
```

**Primary answer (1hr hypoxia, both cell lines).** Cells read `status | TE LFC (padj)`.

```{r primary}
summary_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol_given, transcript_id_given,
                `MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 1hr`, `MCF7-SIX1 hypoxia 1hr`) %>%
  knitr::kable()

calls_long %>%
  filter(dataset %in% c("MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 1hr", "MCF7-SIX1 hypoxia 1hr")) %>%
  dplyr::count(dataset, status) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

**Later 231 hypoxia timepoints** (no MCF7-SIX1 counterpart exists).

```{r later}
summary_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol_given, `MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 4hr`, `MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 24hr`) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

## 3b. Translation category: is the change Exclusive?

Categories come from `categorize_translation_changes()` (`code/functions.R`), with
"significant" meaning padj < 0.05 and **no fold-change cutoff** (`lfc_cutoff = 0`, as at every
call site in this project):

- **Exclusive**: ribosome footprints and TE change, mRNA does not. A purely translational effect.
- **TE_only**: TE changes, neither RNA nor footprints do on their own.
- **Buffered**: RNA changes and TE changes (footprints may or may not), so translation partly offsets the mRNA change.
- **Forwarded**: RNA and footprints change together, TE does not. An mRNA-level effect.

For MDA-MB-231 this is the saved `category` column, re-derived from the three padj columns
below to confirm it used `lfc_cutoff = 0`. For MCF7-SIX1 it comes from
`00_mcf7six1_hypoxia_si3d_categories.Rmd`, which fits the RNA-only and ribo-only contrasts
the saved MCF7-SIX1 file lacks (run that notebook first).

```{r categories}
recat <- function(r, b, t) {
  sr <- !is.na(r) & r < 0.05; sb <- !is.na(b) & b < 0.05; st <- !is.na(t) & t < 0.05
  case_when(sr & sb & !st ~ "Forwarded", !sr & sb & st ~ "Exclusive",
            sr & st ~ "Buffered", st ~ "TE_only", TRUE ~ "Not_sig")
}
for (tp in names(te231)) {
  d <- te231[[tp]]
  stopifnot("231 saved category is not the padj-only (lfc_cutoff = 0) definition" =
              all(recat(d$rna_padj, d$ribo_padj, d$te_padj) == d$category))
}

cat_mcf_path <- here("output", "finding_positive_controls",
                     "mcf7six1_hypoxia_1hr_si3d_rna_ribo_te_categories.csv")
stopifnot("run 00_mcf7six1_hypoxia_si3d_categories.Rmd first" = file.exists(cat_mcf_path))
cat_mcf <- read_csv(cat_mcf_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
# same TE as the file used above
chk <- inner_join(cat_mcf, te_mcf, by = "gene_id_clean")
# Shrinkage changes LFC magnitude a lot for low-count genes, and pulls ~60 non-significant
# genes (padj >= 0.4) across zero; among significant genes the sign must agree.
sig <- chk$te_padj.x < 0.05
stopifnot(nrow(chk) == nrow(te_mcf),
          max(abs(chk$te_padj.x - chk$te_padj.y)) < 1e-8,
          all(sign(chk$te_lfc.x[sig]) == sign(chk$te_lfc.y[sig])))

cat_cols <- function(d, label) d %>%
  transmute(gene_id_clean, dataset = label, category, rna_lfc, rna_padj, ribo_lfc, ribo_padj)
cats_long <- bind_rows(
  cat_cols(te231[["1hr"]],  "MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 1hr"),
  cat_cols(te231[["4hr"]],  "MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 4hr"),
  cat_cols(te231[["24hr"]], "MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 24hr"),
  cat_cols(cat_mcf,         "MCF7-SIX1 hypoxia 1hr")
)
calls_long <- calls_long %>% left_join(cats_long, by = c("gene_id_clean", "dataset"))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(calls_long[c("transcript_id_given", "dataset")]))

calls_long %>%
  filter(dataset %in% c("MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 1hr", "MCF7-SIX1 hypoxia 1hr")) %>%
  mutate(cell = ifelse(present, sprintf("%s | %s | RNA %.2f (%.2g), ribo %.2f (%.2g)",
                                        status, category, rna_lfc, rna_padj, ribo_lfc, ribo_padj),
                       "not detected")) %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol_given, dataset, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = cell) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

The TE log2 fold change in the MCF7-SIX1 category file is unshrunk, so it differs slightly
from the shrunk value in section 3; padj is identical, and the target call uses the section 3
value.

## 4. Is the given isoform the one our matrices use?

The TE call above is gene-level. If the 5'UTR you plan to clone comes from a different isoform
than the dominant one in that cell line, the gene-level TE result may not describe it.
`feature_matrix_tco.rds` (231) and `feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds` (MCF7-SIX1) each hold one
transcript per gene, chosen as that cell line's most-abundant isoform.

```{r isoform}
fm_tx <- function(p) {
  readRDS(here("output", "translational_control_overview", p)) %>%
    distinct(gene_id_clean, transcript_id_clean)
}
iso <- cand %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol_given, transcript_id_given, transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean) %>%
  left_join(fm_tx("feature_matrix_tco.rds") %>%
              dplyr::rename(tx_231 = transcript_id_clean), by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
  left_join(fm_tx("feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds") %>%
              dplyr::rename(tx_mcf7six1 = transcript_id_clean), by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
  mutate(same_as_231      = transcript_id_clean == tx_231,
         same_as_mcf7six1 = transcript_id_clean == tx_mcf7six1)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(iso$transcript_id_given))
iso %>% dplyr::select(-transcript_id_clean, -gene_id_clean) %>% knitr::kable()
```

## 5. Save

```{r save}
out <- calls_long %>%
  left_join(iso %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id_given, tx_231, tx_mcf7six1,
                                  same_as_231, same_as_mcf7six1),
            by = "transcript_id_given")
write_csv(out, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s_eif3d_hypoxia_calls.csv", set_tag)))
cat("Wrote", file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s_eif3d_hypoxia_calls.csv", set_tag)), "\n")
```
